goal: Login routes by region and binds OAuth/OIDC accounts without storing secrets in board records
scenarios: login routes by domain to cn or global without relying only on IP
users can manually switch login region when routing is ambiguous
login events record the region used
Google, GitHub, and WeChat appear as regional OAuth/OIDC providers
OAuth start and callback bind a provider identity with state and PKCE where supported
one user can unlink a bound provider
OAuth secrets are not stored in board records
constraints: do not start Phase D chrome on the fused board cockpit
secrets never persist in board records
